nodes.label: Multi-home centralized data model (User -> Houses)
nodes.rationale: Transitioning from localStorage single-tenant model to a centralized model is required to let multiple users share the same house across devices; team recommends Firebase or Supabase as real backend, but this phase implements only the logic/UI with a simulated service.

nodes.label: Invitation code migration for existing houses (task item)
nodes.norm_label: invitation code migration for existing houses (task item)

nodes.label: Share button integrated in Ajustes (task item)
nodes.norm_label: share button integrated in ajustes (task item)

nodes.label: Per-house isolated localStorage (homemap-house-ID)
nodes.rationale: Each house's data is saved independently keyed by house ID so switching or logging out never mixes inventories between properties.

nodes.label: Automatic invitation code migration for old houses
nodes.norm_label: automatic invitation code migration for old houses

nodes.label: Data model extension: photo + locationHistory fields
nodes.rationale: rooms/zones/containers gain photo:null and objects gain locationHistory:[] so photos and future location-change history can be tracked without breaking existing data, and the base64 storage approach is explicitly a stepping stone toward eventual Supabase Storage migration.
nodes.norm_label: data model extension: photo + locationhistory fields

nodes.label: Data model extension (MEJORAS description)
nodes.rationale: Rooms/zones/containers prepared with photo field, objects with locationHistory, explicitly to be migration-ready for Supabase Storage.

nodes.label: Release signing / keystore.properties
nodes.rationale: keystore.properties and the keystore file must be kept out of version control for security since they hold real signing secrets (storePassword, keyAlias, keyPassword).

nodes.label: Privacy policy: data categories stored (names, photos, local prefs)
nodes.norm_label: privacy policy: data categories stored (names, photos, local prefs)

nodes.label: Terms: third-party AI/backend must be authenticated + HTTPS
nodes.rationale: Any third-party AI provider or external backend must be authenticated and encrypted with HTTPS and comply with applicable privacy policies, to protect user data handled outside the local device.
nodes.norm_label: terms: third-party ai/backend must be authenticated + https

nodes.label: Economy tables RLS policies (multi-casa via home_members)
nodes.rationale: RLS is enabled on all economy tables so users only see data for houses where they are members, validated via the home_members table, to enforce multi-house data isolation.
nodes.norm_label: economy tables rls policies (multi-casa via home_members)
